characters.name: Gudbrand
characters.description: En rolig småbruker øverst i lia som bytter seg nedover fra ku til hane på vei hjem fra markedet, trygg på at kona vil forstå.
characters.look: A short, round, easy-going smallholder of about fifty with a round belly, a shiny bald head, bushy grey-white side-whiskers from his ears down to his jaw, a clean-shaven chin, a big pink nose, small merry blue eyes and a calm, contented smile. He wears a dark-green tweed flat cap, a thick knitted cardigan with a black-and-white snowflake pattern and pewter clasps, brown work trousers and green rubber boots, with a short curved wooden pipe in his breast pocket.

characters.name: Kona
characters.description: Gudbrands kone, som finner noe bra ved alt han finner på, og som følger langt bedre med enn bygda tror.
characters.look: A plump, cheerful woman of about forty-eight, a little shorter than Gudbrand, with a round, beaming face, rosy cheeks, a broad, freckled nose, merry hazel eyes that crinkle when she laughs and grey hair pinned up in a neat bun. She wears a rose-red knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up, a bright cornflower-blue apron, dark jeans and thick grey woollen house socks.

characters.name: Naboen
characters.description: Nærmeste nabo, som er sikker på at Gudbrand får kjeft, vedder hundre tusen kroner på det og lytter ved halvdøra.
characters.look: A nosy, pot-bellied man of about fifty with a round, clean-shaven face, a long, pointed, twitchy nose, narrow doubtful eyes with one eyebrow always raised, big pink ears that stick straight out and short, spiky ginger hair. He wears a brown knitted beanie, a grey-and-orange work jacket with reflective stripes, faded jeans and black rubber boots.

characters.name: Gutten med hanen
characters.description: En tenåring i hettegenser som vil bli kvitt morfarens hane fordi den galer klokka fire hver morgen, og som bytter den mot ei gås.
characters.look: A lanky, sleepy-eyed teenage boy of about fifteen with a pale, narrow face, dark shadows under his eyes, a few spots on his chin and a mop of messy dark-blond hair poking out of his hood. He wears a faded black hoodie with the hood up, grey joggers and muddy white trainers, and holds a cardboard box with a rooster's red comb poking out of the top.

places.name: the Farmhouse Kitchen
places.look: A cosy, cluttered farmhouse kitchen with pale wood-panelled walls: a pine table with mismatched chairs, a black wood stove with a kettle on top, a fridge covered with children's drawings and magnets, rag rugs on a worn wooden floor and a steep, narrow staircase up to the children's rooms. A short hallway with coats, caps and boots on pegs leads to the white front door.
